item.title: NASA SpaceX Crew‑13 Launch: Fastest ISS Docking Ever
item.description: SpaceX’s Crew‑13 lifts off Oct 1, delivering three NASA astronauts and two international crew members to the ISS in a 7‑hour 50‑minute journey, fastest ever.
